_comment: Canonical dinas codes RDT can route a transaction TO (dinas_target). Corrected 29 Jul 2026 (project owner): the previous list was a SYNTHETIC PLACEHOLDER — literally 'T' + every letter A-U sequentially, guessed before the real org structure was available, not GMF's actual GH-level roster. Replaced with the real 21-GH structure from struktur-dinas-gmf.png (project owner supplied): TG/TK/TO/TT never existed as real dinas (dropped); TV/TX/TZ/DFR are real GH units that were simply missing (added) — DFR (Management Risk GH) intentionally doesn't follow the 'T+letter' shape, this list has no length/prefix assumption so that's fine. 'Corp' stays as the separate no-dedicated-PIC catch-all bucket (REQ-RDT-AUTH-04) — unrelated to the org chart, unchanged. 'TMM' added 31 Jul 2026 (project owner correction, superseding the 28 Jul 'GMF-wide sub-dinas suffix convention' theory): TMM is its OWN dinas with its own repost business, NOT a sub-unit of TM reachable via a generic code+suffix guess — explicitly reasserted TAB-wide, so no logic anywhere should ever again derive a 2-letter code by truncating a 3-letter one and treat them as the same dinas (see excelParser.js's resolveSubDinasCode, which still exists for other legitimate cases but is never reached for 'TMM' now that it's an exact-match roster entry). 'TAB' added 4 Aug 2026 (section 3.10 'PERSEMPIT SCOPE' revision, SUPERSEDING the reasoning that used to exclude it here — kept for history, not because it's still true): until then TAB was deliberately excluded because it was considered ONLY an administrative role, never an operational dinas a Remarks prefix could resolve to, and a dinas_target of 'TAB' would have failed the transactions_dinas_target_fkey constraint (rdt.dinas had no row for it). The project owner's share-cost feature now REQUIRES the opposite: 'TAB' must be a legitimate dinas_target VALUE so that rows landing there can be exposed as share-cost split candidates (see routes/shareCost.js's GET /candidates, now scoped to dinas_target='TAB' specifically). migrations/014_tab_share_cost_target.sql adds the matching rdt.dinas row, seeded with is_active=false on purpose — 'TAB' must satisfy the FK and match a real Remarks prefix, but must NOT show up in any is_active=true dinas picker (e.g. reassignment.js's REASSIGN target dropdown) the way an ordinary operational dinas would.
